name: freelancehunt-mcp
description: Freelancehunt (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting, list_messages, send_message. Every tool map

platform_mcp_freelancehunt_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCEHUNT_TOKEN
platform_mcp_freelancehunt_token.description: Personal API token from https://freelancehunt.com/my/api2, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

platform_mcp_freelancehunt_safe_type.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCEHUNT_SAFE_TYPE
platform_mcp_freelancehunt_safe_type.description: Default payment protection for new bids: split, employer, developer or employer_cashless (Safe), per the 'Add bid' docs; leave unset for the platform default.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /v2/projects ('Open projects list'; by default open projects). Pagination is page[number]; filter[skill_id] takes comma-separated skill IDs (GET /v2/skills), so pass skill ids as category. No keyword or budget filter is documented, so query and min_budget are not sent and the page size is the platform's (limit is not sent). budget is a single amount (budget_max) in budget.currency; skills[] are {id, name} objects (raw).

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: GET /v2/threads/{thread_id} ('Thread messages list'); thread_id is required (GET /v2/threads lists threads). from/to are the participants' logins.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: POST /v2/threads/{thread_id} ('Add message to the thread') with {message_html}.
